newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR short-term rates higher.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR short-term rates higher.

text.p: The Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) rose in shorter maturities from one week to one-month, while the rest were steady or lower, traders said on Monday.

The higher domestic interest rates at the money market prodded banks to raise their swap rates for the short term in view of the high demand for funds to cover four days of reserve positions, traders said.
Rates for the other maturities were mostly steady since they were not as vulnerable to the daily changes at the money market, they said.
